title: prunus domestica var. americana
intro: Prunus domestica var. americana, commonly known as wild American plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family, native to eastern North America. The health benefits of Prunus domestica var. americana include its potential to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. Therapeutically, this plant has been used to treat various ailments, including diarrhea, dysentery, and coughs, due to its emollient and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Prunus domestica var. americana include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic actions.
